sources.snippet: Overview gemma-4-12B-it-GGUF is a 12-billion parameter instruction-tuned language model in GGUF quantized format, maintained by ggml-org. This model is part of Google's Gemma 4 family and designed to run efficiently on consumer hardware through GGUF quantization, a format that reduces model size while preserving quality.
